title: Star Light, Star Bright: Can Multimodal Models Parse an Astronomy Visual Question Answering Dataset Right?
abstract: arXiv:2610.22474v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Figures are essential for scientific communication, and the field of Visual Question Answering (VQA) aims to test the figure understanding capabilities of large multimodal models (LMMs). Here, we investigate the accuracy of several low-cost LMMs on domain-specific VQA tasks for astronomical images of the sky. As instrument for this task we build a domain-specific VQA dataset comprising 2001 partially-synthetic figures divided evenly between contour plots, real telescope images drawn from NASA's SkyView, and "fake" sky images which share the axes and angular scales of the real images but draw their colors from a gaussian mixture model, alongside 47357 questions. Each figure is released as pristine and with realistic page-aging degradations mimicking the historical astronomical corpus. Testing three low-cost proprietary LMMs, we find models frequently fail to answer domain-specific questions at high accuracy. An initial comparison with 1

translated_title: 星光璀璨：多模态模型能正确解析天文视觉问答数据集吗？
translated_abstract: 图表是科学交流的重要媒介，而视觉问答（VQA）领域旨在测试大型多模态模型（LMM）理解图表的能力。本文研究了多个低成本LMM在针对天空天文图像的领域特定VQA任务上的准确性。为实现这一目标，我们构建了一个领域特定的VQA数据集，包含2001张部分合成的图表，平均分为三类：等高线图、取自NASA SkyView的真实望远镜图像，以及“伪”天空图像（后者与真实图像共享坐标轴和角尺度，但其颜色由高斯混合模型生成），并配有47357个问题。每张图表均以原始版本发布，同时提供模拟历史天文文献页面老化效果的逼真退化版本。通过对三个低成本专有LMM进行测试，我们发现这些模型经常无法以高准确率回答领域特定问题。与1（注：原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究构建了一个包含2001张天文图像（等高线图、NASA SkyView真实望远镜图像和伪天空图像）及47357个问题的领域特定视觉问答数据集，测试发现低成本多模态大模型难以高准确率地回答天文领域特定问题。
en_tdlr: The study constructs a domain-specific astronomy VQA dataset of 2001 figures (contour plots, real telescope images from NASA's SkyView, and fake sky images) with 47,357 questions, finding that low-cost LMMs frequently fail to answer domain-specific questions at high accuracy.
